problem: The corrosion and abrasion addition has only sh:maxCount 1 and no sh:minCount, so it may be omitted entirely; omission bypasses both the normal 2 mm requirement and the conditional approval/coating requirement for a lower value.
required_change: Add sh:minCount 1 to require exactly one corrosionAbrasionAddition quantity.
regression_guard: Preserve the normal upper bound of 2 mm and the conditional evidence requirements for values below 2 mm.

problem: The conditional check only requires one materialApprovalStatus value to be typed nltl:evidenceState and equal to Approved; it does not constrain all supplied materialApprovalStatus values to the canonical evidenceState range when lower corrosion addition is used.
required_change: Add a property constraint or equivalent conditional validation requiring every materialApprovalStatus value in the lower-addition case to be an instance of nltl:evidenceState, while retaining the required Approved value.
regression_guard: Preserve the canonical nltl:evidenceState range and the requirement for an Approved status.
